artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno powerhouse, KNTXT label boss — hard, hypnotic peak-time techno; a tracked name and one of the strongest bookings on this lineup.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha) — distorted, industrial-leaning club music going back to the mid-2000s Boysnoize Records run; still a reliably weird, high-energy set.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Miami-via-Barcelona producer (Eric Estornel) — tech-house and techno crossover, Ellum Audio boss; deep, dark, groove-driven.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal electro-house institution (Turbo Recordings) — tongue-in-cheek, disco-inflected electro; a real name for the older end of this bill.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ/producer on the harder, rave-leaning end of techno — Bicep's Fabric label, T4T LUV NRG co-founder; a genuinely respected underground name amid the festival billing.

artist_notes.name: Shygirl
artist_notes.note: UK rapper/vocalist and NUXXE co-founder — hyperpop-adjacent club music, Sega Bodega/Arca collaborator; more art-club than DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian tech-house export, Solotoko boss — tracked name; huge festival draw, big-room but genuinely well-selected house.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer of 'Drugs From Amsterdam' fame — tracked name; big-room tech house with a raw, jacking edge.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Swedish-Argentine producer (Armand Jakobsson) who pioneered 'lo-fi house' — tracked name; hazy, nostalgic house that's a shade more tasteful than most of this bill.

artist_notes.name: Chris Lorenzo
artist_notes.note: UK bass/house producer, Half Baked label — tracked name; UK garage-inflected, bass-heavy house.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival — one of the more interesting names on the bill if you like that skippy, rave-adjacent garage sound.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

artist_notes.name: Andy C
artist_notes.note: UK drum & bass legend, RAM Records boss — outside the house/techno lane but a genuine, decades-deep DJ talent if you catch a set.

4dd13aaa260f.curator_note: This is the maximalist, 68-name-deep HARD Summer bill — Charlotte de Witte, VTSS and Amelie Lens give the techno stage real weight, but the day is mostly festival-scale bass/electro/hyperpop stuff outside the lane. Go for a handful of sets, not the whole grounds.
4dd13aaa260f.description: Day one of HARD Summer at Hollywood Park Grounds, Inglewood — 60+ act electronic/bass festival lineup including Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens, VTSS, DJ Snake, Boys Noize and Zedd.

d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: A dedicated day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set at Grand Park, not a shared festival stage — genuinely the better way to catch her than the HARD Summer slot the same month. Extended techno-into-acid-into-trance from a real headliner in a proper Factory 93 room.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents a solo, day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set (techno, acid, trance) at Grand Park Block 2, DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Polo & Pan
artist_notes.note: French duo (Paul Armand-Delille & Alexandre Grynszpan) doing lush, tropical-tinged synth-pop and disco touches — a strong, Balearic-adjacent opening act even if the headliner isn't your lane.

c24037cc642d.curator_note: Empire of the Sun's costume-heavy glam-pop is out of the house/techno lane, but Polo & Pan opening at the Bowl is worth showing up on time for — their sound leans closer to the Balearic/groove stuff you actually chase.
c24037cc642d.description: Empire of the Sun's 'Ask That God: Afterlife' tour stop at the Hollywood Bowl, with Polo & Pan and Midnight Generation opening.

artist_notes.name: Knock2
artist_notes.note: US producer straddling bass music and pop-leaning electronic — big festival-stage energy, outside the house/techno lane.

52241f8a3d48.curator_note: Day two of HARD Summer is the thinner bill for this lane — Amelie Lens and Vintage Culture again, but otherwise skews bass/hyperpop. Only worth it if you're already at the grounds from day one.
52241f8a3d48.description: Day two of HARD Summer at Hollywood Park Grounds, Inglewood, with Amelie Lens, Vintage Culture, Zedd, DJ Snake, RL Grime and Boys Noize among others.

edab80bd44cb.curator_note: Overmono is a tracked name and this is a proper club date, not a festival slot — the Gawsworth brothers' rave-nostalgic breaks-and-melody sound (Fabric, Warp) translates well to the Palladium's room, with a dedicated Vinyl Room opening early at 6:30.
edab80bd44cb.description: UK duo Overmono's 'Pure Devotion' world tour stops at Hollywood Palladium, doors 8pm with a 6:30pm Vinyl Room opener.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

artist_notes.name: Lee Burridge
artist_notes.note: UK DJ, founder of All Day I Dream — melodic, organic, Balearic-leaning house; about as close to the European sunset-groove reference point as a festival lineup gets.

artist_notes.name: Justin Martin
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird co-founder — bouncy, quirky, bass-inflected West Coast house ('Sasquatch', 'Buggin''); SF scene royalty.

artist_notes.name: Radio Slave
artist_notes.note: Matt Edwards' techier alias — Rekids co-founder, ex-Ministry of Sound resident; propulsive, muscular house/techno, a genuinely European-pedigreed booking.

artist_notes.name: Mikey Lion
artist_notes.note: Desert Hearts co-founder — psychedelic house/techno out of the SoCal camping-rave scene, warmer and trippier than straight club fare.

artist_notes.name: DJ Colette
artist_notes.note: Chicago house vocalist/DJ (Om Records, Skint) — classic Chicago-lineage vocal house, been in the game since the late '90s.

artist_notes.name: Anton Tumas
artist_notes.note: Subtract Music founder — deep house/techno/hypnotic-electronica selector who ran the beloved 'Subtract On The Pier' Long Beach series; genuinely well-regarded in the SoCal deep-house underground.

artist_notes.name: DAVI
artist_notes.note: Armenian-born, LA-based progressive house producer — early support from Hernan Cattaneo, Nick Warren, John Digweed; polished melodic-prog rather than raw underground.

86ca88c4e980.curator_note: This is a real house-music bill, not a generic festival dump — Doc Martin and Lee Burridge alone give it actual lineage, and DJ Minx (already tracked) plus Radio Slave add European/Detroit weight. Long Beach is a haul, but the depth of this lineup earns it.
86ca88c4e980.description: Love Long Beach Festival at Shoreline Aquatic Park, 2pm, with a house/tech-house lineup including Doc Martin, Justin Martin, Lee Burridge, Radio Slave, Mikey Lion and DJ Minx.

artist_notes.name: Luke Mele
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector with a long-running NTS Radio show spanning Balearic house, dub techno, ambient and trip-hop — a genuine home-listening digger, exactly the vinyl-only lane you like.

artist_notes.name: Taylor Shockley
artist_notes.note: House/ambient/minimal/dub DJ with credits on Insomniac and Mixcloud — smaller name, limited verifiable bio beyond active gigging.

9a0fd9893571.curator_note: A location-TBA all-vinyl night built around Luke Mele's NTS-honed Balearic/ambient/dub sensibility is squarely the listening-bar format worth chasing an address for — quieter and more textural than a peak-time club night.
9a0fd9893571.description: 'Information' all-vinyl night at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm, with Taylor Shockley, Luke Mele and CHOÍCE.

artist_notes.name: Nick León
artist_notes.note: Miami producer on TraTraTrax and Future Times — fuses dembow, reggaeton and dancehall rhythm into house/techno (his own coined term: 'arquitectronica'); one of the more genuinely distinctive club producers right now, sun-bleached and heavy in equal measure.

a4c21a0657c3.curator_note: An all-night TBA set from Nick León isn't a straight house night — it's Miami dembow-and-dancehall rhythm woven into club music, which makes this one of the more interesting bookings in this batch if you want something that doesn't sound like everything else on the calendar.
a4c21a0657c3.description: CSW presents Nick León for an all-night set at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara headlining Midnight Lovers is a legitimate European-club booking — Berghain-lineage electro-disco with Masha Mar and James Axon rounding it out with LA's own deep-house/dublab crowd. This is the kind of night the fabric-London comparison is actually built for.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin's Massimiliano Pagliara at The Bridge, DTLA, with Masha Mar and James Axon, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: DRAMA
artist_notes.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

48e360ba751a.curator_note: Sofi Tukker at the Greek is a Spotify-core-rotation lock, not a discovery pick — a fun big-room night if you're already a fan, and DRAMA's a genuinely tasteful opener rather than filler.
48e360ba751a.description: Sofi Tukker headlines the Greek Theatre with support from DRAMA, 7:30pm.

cf044cb77173.curator_note: Indie-disco format built explicitly around Justice/LCD/Disclosure/Daft Punk — the dance-floor-friendly end of indie rather than a real DJ-selection night; fun if you want familiar bangers over discovery, less interesting than the house/techno options this week.
cf044cb77173.description: 'Midnite City: Indie Disco' at The Moroccan Lounge, Arts District, 9:30pm — an indie/electro dance night playing Justice, LCD Soundsystem, Disclosure and similar, with ORLOVE.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Certified Groovers landing Gene On Earth is a nice get — his Limousine Dream sound is more minimal-and-breaks-leaning than most of the TBA-warehouse bills this month, worth it if you want something a shade weirder than straight house.
3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers presents Gene On Earth at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Markus Schulz
artist_notes.note: German-American trance veteran (Coldharbour Recordings founder, longtime top-10 DJ Mag placement) — progressive trance with techno and D&B influences. Well outside the house/techno lane; a big trance name, not a groove/European-house one.

bdd53b3c89a5.curator_note: A trance open-to-close set is a genuinely different genre from the rooftop-groove and tech-house lane — Schulz is a legitimate name in that world, just not this one, so this is more 'know it exists' than 'go.'
bdd53b3c89a5.description: Markus Schulz plays an open-to-close trance set at Avalon Hollywood, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno moving between punchy, minimal and broken-beat, with dreamy melodic turns; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcast series.

artist_notes.name: bilaliwood
artist_notes.note: NYC/LA DJ, ex-child actor — plays tasteful, left-of-center selections across genres; regular on the DāM-Funk/Fusicology TBA-party orbit.

5a954993cb7d.curator_note: A Disconic TBA lineup with real depth on paper — Kana Hishiya's melodic house/techno range and bilaliwood's crate-digger reputation both check out — but Juniör and John Smith don't have a verifiable footprint, so treat this as a solid-not-certain underground bet.
5a954993cb7d.description: Disconic presents Juniör, Kana Hishiya, John Smith and bilaliwood at a TBA Los Angeles location, 11pm.

968c997e8e52.curator_note: Christopher Nolan's Homer adaptation — shot entirely on Imax film stock, Matt Damon as Odysseus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope — is a legitimate see-it-on-film event, and a Friday-night 70mm slot at Vista is the right way in if you can get a seat. Worth confirming Vista is actually running one of the ~30 true 70mm prints before you build the night around it.
968c997e8e52.description: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' (2026), starring Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway, screening in 70mm at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 10:30pm.

f5167e64ce20.curator_note: Kevin Reynolds' 1985 cult favorite — Kevin Costner's first starring role, five Texas college friends on one last road trip before the draft — is a low-stakes, unpretentious rep pick if you want something warm and funny rather than heavy on a Saturday night.
f5167e64ce20.description: Kevin Reynolds' 1985 comedy-drama 'Fandango,' starring Kevin Costner in his first lead role, at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 8pm.

85002ef88213.curator_note: Same reliable Gold Diggers disco residency as always — no headliner, just the house selectors doing boogie and classic house in a small East Hollywood room a short hop from Silver Lake. Easy default if nothing bigger is pulling you elsewhere.
85002ef88213.description: 'The Hustle' first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers, East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Stavroz
artist_notes.note: Belgian four-piece live band — organic, cinematic electronic music blending acoustic textures with emotive melodies (breakout tracks 'The Finishing,' 'Gold Town'); Coachella and Pukkelpop alumni, half a million-plus monthly Spotify listeners. A live act, not a DJ set.

66a16855b568.curator_note: Stavroz play live rather than DJ, so this is closer to the Bonobo/RÜFÜS Du Sol live-electronic lane than a club night — warm, cinematic, built for a room that wants to feel rather than peak. A good pick if you want the melodic-organic end of the taste without the warehouse chase.
66a16855b568.description: STRANGER THAN presents Stavroz, the Belgian live organic-electronic band, at The Bridge, DTLA, 10pm.

43fef8a9bc07.curator_note: A straight 2010-2015 pop-and-EDM nostalgia night — no DJ billing, no real selection angle, just a themed party. Skip unless the throwback premise itself is the draw.
43fef8a9bc07.description: 'Sorry For Party Rocking' — a 2010-2015 pop and EDM nostalgia night at Catch One, Mid-City, 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Orion 224
artist_notes.note: Houston indie/alt-rock four-piece (formed 2016) fronted by Cristian Gonzalez — melodic guitar-driven indie rock.

artist_notes.name: Cannon the Dealers
artist_notes.note: Brownsville, TX 'indie-sleaze' four-piece — nostalgic early-2000s indie rock/shoegaze/hardcore blend, Strokes/Red Pears lineage; touring behind their album 'Still Too Soon.'

f6c03e7501c5.curator_note: A touring Texas indie-rock double bill — Orion 224's melodic guitars and Cannon the Dealers' scrappier indie-sleaze — landing at the Moroccan for an all-ages Friday. Solidly in the small-club live-band lane, just not a big enough name to build a night around; good if you're already in the Arts District.
f6c03e7501c5.description: Touring Texas indie-rock bill: Orion 224 with Cannon the Dealers and American Woman, at The Moroccan Lounge, Arts District, doors 9:30pm, all ages.

f5b82221f3da.curator_note: This is Kinji Fukasaku's 'Battles Without Honor and Humanity' under its literal Japanese-title translation — the documentary-style, ultra-violent yakuza classic that basically invented the jitsuroku genre. A great pick if you want something bracing instead of another comfort rep-watch.
f5b82221f3da.description: Kinji Fukasaku's 1973 yakuza classic 'Battles Without Honor and Humanity' ('Jingi Naki Tatakai'), screening at Vista Theater, Los Feliz, 8pm.

dd2fa322c507.curator_note: No billed lineup beyond a house crew name and a bare RA listing — could be a fine Chinatown day-party, but there's nothing here yet to confirm the selection is worth planning around.
dd2fa322c507.description: Saturday afternoon party (4pm) at Apotheke in Chinatown with in-house Discotheke resident DJs; no billed lineup.

6226db547d03.curator_note: A Vista holiday-in-July screening — no film title on the listing yet, so hard to say if it's a must or just counter-programming. Worth a look when the actual title posts.
6226db547d03.description: Themed "Christmas in July" screening at the Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 8pm; specific film not yet listed.

99dad68671e5.curator_note: SEBASTIANE's a solid excuse to end up at Akbar late — Silver Lake's tiny, unpretentious queer bar rather than a proper club room, so go in expecting a packed dive-bar dancefloor, not a big production.
99dad68671e5.description: Late-night party (10pm) at Akbar, Silver Lake's longtime queer neighborhood bar, with DJs Sindri and Mondo Nexus.

75b858e80852.curator_note: Fun if you're into K-pop specifically, but it's a themed sing-along dance night off Top-40 hits rather than a DJ set with any real selection behind it — outside the lane unless that's exactly what you're after.
75b858e80852.description: K-pop themed late-night dance party at The Moroccan Lounge in the Arts District, doors 9:30pm, 21+, playing hits from BLACKPINK, BTS, TWICE, and others.

14f118b7b429.curator_note: Sidney Lumet's jury-room classic on the big screen — tight, tense, and a genuine credit to anyone's rep-cinema habit; hard to go wrong with this one at the Vista.
14f118b7b429.description: Screening of Sidney Lumet's 1957 courtroom drama "12 Angry Men" at the Vista Theater in Los Feliz, 8pm.

artist_notes.name: DJ Slugo
artist_notes.note: Chicago ghetto-house/footwork pioneer, founding Dance Mania crew alongside DJ Deeon and Paul Johnson — raw, high-BPM, chant-hook club tracks; the sound Daft Punk sampled on 'Teachers.'

1c8c064e1849.curator_note: Baile World is one of LA's best global-club rooms (founded by DJ CQUESTT, built around femme/POC selectors), and landing a Dance Mania originator like DJ Slugo is a real coup — footwork/ghetto-house rather than straight house, so know what you're walking into, but it'll move.
1c8c064e1849.description: Secret-location DTLA afterhours party (11pm) from the Baile World series, headlined by Chicago ghetto-house pioneer DJ Slugo.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

e1b7f6d3e828.curator_note: Scotty Boy plays it safe and populist — reliable jackin'-house-and-disco-edits energy for a Koreatown late night, but it's closer to brunch-party polish than a proper selector's set.
e1b7f6d3e828.description: Late-night disco/house party (10pm) at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown headlined by house DJ/producer Scotty Boy.

artist_notes.name: Nikki Nair
artist_notes.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

artist_notes.name: George Daniel
artist_notes.note: The 1975's drummer moonlighting as a dance producer/DJ — founded the label dh2 out of afterparty DJ sets; plays bass-leaning, UK-rap-inflected electronic sets, not a genre veteran but a genuine crate-digger's side project.

1e743c3f1597.curator_note: Lights Down Low has been LA/Bay Area's best-kept afterhours secret for over a decade, and Nikki Nair is one of the most inventive bass-techno hybridizers going right now — a real reason to stay out late even with a curiosity booking like George Daniel on the same bill.
1e743c3f1597.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (11pm) from long-running party Lights Down Low, featuring bass/techno producer Nikki Nair and The 1975's George Daniel (dh2 label) DJing.

artist_notes.name: EMBRZ
artist_notes.note: Dublin producer (Jack Casey) making atmospheric, vocal-forward melodic house — signed to Lane 8's This Never Happened label; downtempo-leaning and emotive rather than peak-time.

ccfacd3e3b24.curator_note: A rooftop sunset set from a This Never Happened-orbit artist is squarely the golden-hour-groove lane — EMBRZ leans dreamier and more vocal than a straight house DJ, good for the early slot rather than the whole night.
ccfacd3e3b24.description: Sunset rooftop set (5pm) at Harbor House DTLA with Dublin melodic-house producer EMBRZ.

artist_notes.name: Isaac Carter
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer, vocal-led deep house on his own Ochi imprint — championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison and Seth Troxler; UK-club lineage (Chicago/Detroit roots filtered through contemporary UK dance).

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jake Lubell) making analog, vinyl-informed house with a wide festival footprint (Lightning in a Bottle, Desert Hearts, Dirtybird Campout) — eclectic and percussive rather than a strict selector.

6a22d168fab3.curator_note: Isaac Carter's UK deep-house pedigree (that Ben UFO/Seth Troxler co-sign carries real weight) makes this a stronger TBA-DTLA afterhours than the billing alone suggests — a legit late-night option once Harrison BDP fills in the middle.
6a22d168fab3.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (starts midnight) with London deep-house producer Isaac Carter, Welsh DJ Harrison BDP, and LA's Lubelski.

artist_notes.name: Phantoms
artist_notes.note: LA duo (Kyle Kaplan, Vinnie Pergola) blurring house and indie-dance — 'alternative electronic,' now on Foreign Family, ODESZA's label. Bigger-room, hooky and radio-adjacent rather than a selector's set.

efabc7dd6d6a.curator_note: This is DTLA pool-party energy from a duo built for festival middle-slots, not the rooftop-groove thing — fine if you want an afternoon out at Level 8, but there's no real DJ-selection angle here.
efabc7dd6d6a.description: Daytime pool party at Level 8 DTLA headlined by LA electronic duo Phantoms, 2pm start.

24a39bacb767.curator_note: A stadium pop show, not the lane — this is here on Spotify-affinity signal alone, not selection or scene fit. Skip unless you're a Karol G fan going for the spectacle itself.
24a39bacb767.description: Karol G's 'Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour' stadium show at SoFi Stadium, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: DJ Rashida
artist_notes.note: Rashida Gonzalez Robinson — spent a decade as Prince's touring/opening DJ and played his private parties; genuinely the person to trust with a Prince set, not a stunt booking.

1c14235e465f.curator_note: Moodymann and someone who was actually in Prince's inner circle playing his catalog at the Regent is a real pairing, not a novelty theme night — a Detroit deep-house legend's crate plus Rashida's insider Prince knowledge should make for a genuinely soulful room rather than a covers-band vibe.
1c14235e465f.description: Moodymann and DJ Rashida DJ an all-Prince set at The Regent Theater, doors 8pm, 18+.

7de9287d2683.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this one — same free weekly disco/house format Kiss Kiss Bang Bang always runs, low-stakes and fine as a starter stop, but there's nothing here to build a night around until names drop.
7de9287d2683.description: Paradisco, a recurring disco/house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Man Man
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-born experimental rock band led by Honus Honus (Ryan Kattner) — theatrical, maximalist arrangements (sousaphone, marimba, toy noisemakers) somewhere between carnival music and art-punk. Toured with Modest Mouse; now LA-based.

artist_notes.name: American Tomahawk
artist_notes.note: LA indie/alt-rock trio (not the Mike Patton supergroup of the same-ish name) — small local footprint, couldn't verify much beyond the billing.

4819e7c77dd7.curator_note: Man Man are the real thing if you want the weird, maximalist end of the live-band lane — theatrical and unpredictable in a way most Echoplex bills aren't. Good pick if you're doing the indie/rock night instead of a dancefloor.
4819e7c77dd7.description: Man Man, the theatrical Philly-born experimental rock band, headlines the Echoplex with American Tomahawk opening, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: Ken Ishii
artist_notes.note: Japanese techno pioneer since the mid-90s R&S Records run — 'Extra,' with its Koji Morimoto (Akira)-directed video, is a genre touchstone; now releases on his own 70 Drums imprint. A real legacy booking.

artist_notes.name: Phara
artist_notes.note: Brussels DJ, a Fuse resident since 2016 — vinyl-only sets pulling from Detroit/Berlin/UK techno plus post-punk and EBM, runs the Phaaar label.

artist_notes.name: yNOTi
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ/producer (Sydney J) with classical-violin training — dark, driving techno; has shared bills with Truncate and SPFDJ, a rising local name.

ed9bf8169bd8.curator_note: Ken Ishii is a genuine 90s techno legend and Phara's a proper Fuse-Brussels vinyl selector — a rare TBA bill with real international pedigree instead of just local warehouse regulars.
ed9bf8169bd8.description: WORK's TBA LA warehouse afterhours with 90s techno pioneer Ken Ishii, Brussels' Phara, and LA's yNOTi, 11pm.

67bad413805f.description: Lumasi electronic DJ night at 1720 in Arts District (21:00).

artist_notes.name: Max Cooper
artist_notes.note: UK electronic composer with a PhD in computational biology — his 3D/AV Live show pairs the new Feeling Is Structure album with an immersive light/visual system built per-venue; sits closer to a neo-classical/techno crossover concert than a club DJ set.

8e3111524b41.curator_note: This is a seated-or-standing audiovisual concert, not a club night — Max Cooper's blend of techno pulse and orchestral scope makes it a legitimate stop if you're into the Jon Hopkins/Nils Frahm end of electronic music, less so if you're after a dancefloor.
8e3111524b41.description: Max Cooper's immersive 3D/AV Live show — his Feeling Is Structure album plus career-spanning material — at the Belasco Theater, DTLA, standing-room, all ages.

cb059843dc01.description: Ann the Raven birthday party with DJ at The Redwood Bar DTLA (18:00).

72d0c9d5c231.curator_note: Solid country-radio band, but it's a casino gig out in Cabazon — outside the lane and a real drive for it.
72d0c9d5c231.description: Country group Midland performs at Morongo Casino Resort and Spa in Cabazon.

artist_notes.name: Reverberation Radio
artist_notes.note: LA-connected psych/dub/post-punk/avant-garde mix series tied to the Aquarium Drunkard music journal (Teragram anniversary shows, guest-mix swaps) — more crate-dig radio show than club-DJ brand.

artist_notes.name: Norwood Fisher
artist_notes.note: Fishbone's bassist/co-founder for four decades — funk-punk-metal crossover pioneer; Blackened Sabbath is his project reworking Black Sabbath's catalog through a Black-rock lens with a rotating band of heavy-scene players.

8141b262f919.curator_note: Worth flagging: the score's crediting this to tracked artist FISHER, but that's a scoring collision — this is Fishbone's Norwood Fisher, not the house DJ. On its own merits it's a fun, out-of-lane curiosity at a small East Hollywood room, not a pass-or-skip lane call.
8141b262f919.description: Fishbone bassist Norwood Fisher's Blackened Sabbath project (Black Sabbath's catalog reworked through funk/metal) plays Gold Diggers with support from The Lolly Bombs.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer of 'Drugs From Amsterdam' fame — tracked name; big-room tech house with a raw, jacking edge.

82c5013339e2.curator_note: A tracked-name afters booking at a proper industrial event space — this is the kind of late-night tech-house afters worth actually staying out for, Dreya V support notwithstanding (no read on her).
82c5013339e2.description: Official HARDfest afters with tracked tech-house name Mau P and Dreya V at Mission Four (Ace/Mission Studios), 10pm.

e8925cfb2896.curator_note: This is not tracked-artist FISHER — that's a scoring collision on the name. It's a covers duo doing Sonny & Cher-style 70s rock/disco hits at a Bel Air jazz supper club; fine dinner-and-a-show filler, not a lane pick.
e8925cfb2896.description: Fisher and Thames play a 70s rock-and-disco covers set (a 'modern-day Sonny and Cher') at Vibrato Grill Jazz, 7pm show.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, Planet Mu signee, and Hood Rave co-founder; weaves footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through a Black-diasporic, femme lens. NTS/Dublab host.

artist_notes.name: DJ Noir
artist_notes.note: LA selector (Phyliss Jaxson) affiliated with Juke Bounce Werk and dublab's radio community — footwork/juke and bass-leaning sets.

artist_notes.name: Boo Lean
artist_notes.note: Lauren Goshinski — NYC/LA selector, VIA Festival co-founder, now a Public Records/Lot Radio resident; eclectic, genre-blurring sets moving through dub, drum-play and melodic vocal house.

artist_notes.name: Spiñorita
artist_notes.note: Angela Ramirez — Alhambra-raised Chicana DJ and host of NTS's Casual Play; disco, house, funk and vinyl-digging roots, a fixture of LA's underground/backyard party scene since 2010.

30307819ce98.curator_note: Four deep, genre-blurring LA selectors on a dublab-curated bill at a scrappy Lincoln Heights bar — this is the vinyl-digging, eclectic-groove night the lane exists for, and it's close to home.
30307819ce98.description: Dublab-presented DJ night at The Airliner in Lincoln Heights with BAE BAE, DJ Noir, Boo Lean and Spiñorita.

artist_notes.name: Lil Texas
artist_notes.note: Texas producer behind 'Texcore' — 200+ BPM gabber/Frenchcore fused with Southern rave theatrics; released on Masters of Hardcore and Barong Family, did the 2021 Gaga/Elton John hardcore remix. Also runs a slower techno alias, Diamond Dallas.

a1c0a15b4f6e.curator_note: This is full-tilt 200 BPM gabber/hardcore, not house or techno — a clear miss for this lane unless that's specifically what you're chasing tonight.
a1c0a15b4f6e.description: Hardcore/gabber DJ set from Texcore producer Lil Texas at Exchange LA.

artist_notes.name: VILENA
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer playing groovy, deep, driving techno with a progressive edge; featured on Spectrum Radio's global techno platform — a solid underground booking, not a marquee name.

570f511d469c.curator_note: A trans-community underground techno night with a decent, if not marquee, local booking in VILENA — worth a look for the room/cause as much as the lineup.
570f511d469c.description: Trans*cendent — underground techno party at a TBA DTLA location, featuring VILENA.

artist_notes.name: Jody Wisternoff
artist_notes.note: Bristol DJ/producer, one half of veteran duo Way Out West, and a co-curator of Anjunadeep's flagship annual mix series — deep, melodic progressive house that's exactly the Anjuna-adjacent sound this rooftop lane runs on.

d91d029d98b5.curator_note: This is the template: daytime rooftop pool party, melodic progressive house from an actual Anjunadeep mainstay. Build the Saturday around it.
d91d029d98b5.description: FLOAT rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA (2-8pm) with Anjunadeep's Jody Wisternoff.

308d8c70e03c.curator_note: Open-air garden party in East Hollywood with an unfamiliar name on the decks — the format (daytime, outdoor, garden) fits the lane, but there's nothing solid to say about the lineup itself.
308d8c70e03c.description: Organica garden party at a TBA open-air venue in East Hollywood, featuring Miguel Rincon.

artist_notes.name: VLTRA (IT)
artist_notes.note: Sicilian tech-house duo (Samuele Giambona & Riccardo Anzalone) — Beatport-chart regulars since 'Zilla' on Lee Foss's Repopulate Mars, collabs with The Martinez Brothers and Loco Dice, now touring Tomorrowland/Elrow-tier stages.

7e22ce3805ff.curator_note: A genuinely festival-caliber Italian tech-house duo playing a sausage restaurant's beer garden in Venice — an odd room for the booking, which is exactly what makes it fun.
7e22ce3805ff.description: Tech-house night at Wurstküche's Venice Beach beer garden with Italian duo VLTRA (IT) and Stoley.

artist_notes.name: Chambord
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/production duo — eclectic, melodic sets pulling in world-music textures alongside more hypnotic electronic passages; a reasonable fit for FLOAT's rooftop-groove daytime format.

425ea1314810.curator_note: Same FLOAT rooftop-pool formula as the Wisternoff date a week earlier — Chambord's a local, eclectic-melodic booking rather than a marquee name, but the setting alone earns it a look.
425ea1314810.description: FLOAT rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA (2-8pm) with local duo Chambord.

6f8d76827115.curator_note: This is LA's underground Brazilian baile-funk party (Victoria Moura's Club Pivete) — a fun, scrappy corner of the DTLA underground, but it's baile funk/global bass, not house-techno, so treat it as a curiosity rather than a top pick.
6f8d76827115.description: Club Pivete — underground Brazilian baile funk party at a TBA DTLA location, midnight start.

artist_notes.name: Pegassi
artist_notes.note: Belgian producer (Sam Huybrecht) running his own label/party series Sweet Nothing — a deliberately 'post-genre' set that swings between trance, techno, eurodance and house rather than staying in a lane. Closer to a big-room selector than a groove/disco DJ.

306e63bffa16.curator_note: Late Exchange LA night from a guy who's built a whole identity on not picking a genre — trance-y, eurodance-inflected, more festival-adjacent than a proper house/tech-house selector's set.
306e63bffa16.description: Late-night club set from Belgian genre-blurring producer Pegassi at Exchange LA, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Massane
artist_notes.note: French melodic-house producer and guitarist — debut EP and album on Lane 8's This Never Happened, plus a release on mau5trap. Guitar-textured, emotive melodic house that sits right next to the Anjunadeep/Lane 8 end of the spectrum.

cf4ad9ed7a48.curator_note: A real melodic-house name on the bill, not just a pool-party placeholder — Massane's on Lane 8's own label, so expect the same lush, guitar-inflected builds, just poolside at 2pm instead of a dark room at midnight.
cf4ad9ed7a48.description: Daytime rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA with French melodic-house producer Massane, 2-8pm.

e8ff8c423d38.curator_note: Full arena pop spectacle at SoFi, not the lane at all — this only shows up on Spotify-affinity, so it's a go-if-you're-actually-a-fan pick, not a curated one.
e8ff8c423d38.description: Karol G's "Viajando Por El Mundo" Tropitour stadium show at SoFi Stadium, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: Maddix
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer known for a hard-hitting techno/big-room/trance crossover (breakout track 'Ecstasy'), Revealed Recordings-affiliated. Mainstage-built and harder-edged than the refined techno end of the lane (Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens) — closer to festival trance-techno.

d6d919ad1b86.curator_note: This is festival-mainstage techno-trance at the Palladium, not a selector's night — fun if you want a big, hard-hitting 18+/21+ room, but it's not the fabric-style end of things.
d6d919ad1b86.description: Big-room techno/trance set from Dutch producer Maddix at Hollywood Palladium, 10pm, 18+/21+.

28b893e6e79d.curator_note: The Fast and the Furious turns 25 — a fun communal big-screen outing at the Vista, but it's blockbuster nostalgia more than a rep-cinema curation pick.
28b893e6e79d.description: 25th-anniversary theatrical screening of The Fast and the Furious (2001) at the Vista Theater, Los Feliz.

f73b4538e2c2.description: Afterhours electronic party at Homage Brewing in Pomona (10pm).

artist_notes.note: Dutch-Turkish techno DJ/producer — high-tempo, hard-driving peak-time techno, a regular on the international festival/club circuit. Refined-end-of-techno rather than melodic.

artist_notes.note: UK-born, now LA-based tech-house producer (real name Jacob Plant) — runs his own label TECHNE Records, broke through via Chris Lake/Skrillex's HOWSLA and the platinum single 'Summer 91.' Crowd-pleasing but well-crafted house/tech-house, the mainstream end of the lane this taste explicitly wants.

e653cbe40068.curator_note: Noizu's the kind of big-tent tech-house that earns its Spotify rotation honestly — not the deepest cut of the night but a properly good one for a bigger room like the Shrine.

880d4a67db6c.curator_note: A 25th-anniversary big-screen Fast & Furious at the Vista is pure popcorn nostalgia rather than the arthouse rep-cinema lane, but it's the Vista and it'll be a rowdy, fun crowd for it.

artist_notes.name: Durante
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, LA-based progressive/melodic house producer on Anjunadeep — hypnotic, groove-driven sets sitting between deep house and techno; released his debut album 'Enter' on Anjunadeep in 2024, collaborators include Amtrac and Diplo. Same melodic/Anjuna orbit as Lane 8 and Yotto.

dcc3f7d675a5.curator_note: A rooftop pool party with an Anjunadeep-orbit melodic house DJ is about as close to the Sunset Sessions feeling as it gets on a random weekday afternoon — this is the one to build the day around.
dcc3f7d675a5.description: Daytime rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA featuring Anjunadeep producer Durante, 2-8pm.

artist_notes.name: Die Spitz
artist_notes.note: All-female Austin punk band (signed to Jack White's Third Man Records) known for riotous, chaotic live shows — has opened for Foo Fighters, Amyl and the Sniffers, and Sleater-Kinney.

artist_notes.name: Rachel Chinouriri
artist_notes.note: London-born, Zimbabwean-British indie/alt-pop singer-songwriter — 2024 debut album charted UK top 20, two BRIT nominations; toured with Sabrina Carpenter.

233fd1bfe94c.curator_note: Olivia Rodrigo's first festival is a genuinely stacked, curated bill — Bikini Kill next to Mitski next to Stevie Nicks is a real lineup, not just a pop show — but it's Irvine on a Saturday and this isn't the electronic lane at all, so it's more 'worth knowing about' than 'worth the drive' unless the day is already built around it.
233fd1bfe94c.description: Olivia Rodrigo's all-women debut festival at Great Park Live, Irvine, with Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, Garbage, Bikini Kill, The Breeders and guests Stevie Nicks, Karen O and Sarah McLachlan.

a56bf892f5d4.curator_note: Chai Rave is LA's South Asian/Bollywood party crew, not a European-house night — same great Level 8 rooftop as Sunset Sessions, but the sound is Indo-house/Bollywood-fusion rather than the deep groove lane, so go for the room and the vibe, not expecting a fabric-style set.
a56bf892f5d4.description: One-year-anniversary rooftop day party from Chai Rave LA (South Asian/Bollywood-fusion party series) at Level 8 DTLA.

artist_notes.name: DJ Susan
artist_notes.note: Alias of Steven Glathe (Hood Politics Records, San Diego) — bass/tech-house built for big builds and gritty drops, several Beatport #1s. More festival-EDM energy than a groove selector.

f78e396da172.curator_note: Labor Day rooftop pool party checks the setting boxes (near home, Saturday, open-air), but DJ Susan is a build-and-drop bass-house guy, not a digger — go for the pool and the day-drinking, not a deep set.
f78e396da172.description: Labor Day Saturday daytime pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8's rooftop deck headlined by bass/tech-house DJ Susan.

d8703a4e567c.description: Late-night (10pm) disco/house party in the Paradisco series at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang, Koreatown — lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Bayymack
artist_notes.note: LA-based artist blending hip-hop, pop and rock (alt-hip-hop/'scene' crossover — collabs with 6arelyhuman, Lil Raven) — not a DJ/producer in the house-techno sense.

3311cff0ac9d.curator_note: This reads as a Y2K/'scene'-revival night built around Bayymack's hip-hop-pop, not a house or techno booking — fun if you're into that throwback-emo-rap aesthetic, but it's not really your lane despite the late-night 1720 slot.
3311cff0ac9d.description: Late-night (10pm) Y2K-themed 'scene' party at 1720 in the Arts District with alt-hip-hop artist Bayymack.

artist_notes.name: Apache
artist_notes.note: Miami-based, French-born DJ/producer on Abracadabra Records (Miami house/techno label) and founder of the Soundtuary party series — warm, groove-driven house suited to a rooftop-pool crowd.

e46641e7b265.curator_note: A genuine rooftop-pool day party — Apache isn't a name you'll recognize, but Abracadabra's house lane is legit groove, not brostep-adjacent EDM, and the setting alone (2-8pm, DTLA rooftop) is the Sunset-Sessions kind of afternoon you like.
e46641e7b265.description: Daytime rooftop pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8 DTLA headlined by Miami house DJ Apache.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

307344a761b7.curator_note: Same Scotty Boy energy you'd expect from him anywhere — reliable jackin'-house-and-disco-edits, but it's closer to populist brunch-party polish than a proper selector's after-hours set.
307344a761b7.description: Late-night (10pm) disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown headlined by house DJ/producer Scotty Boy.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina
artist_notes.note: Philly institution, 25+ years in — founder of Jump n Funk (North America's original Afrobeat party) and one of the great genre-agnostic all-night selectors, moving through house, soul, afrobeat, funk, breaks and rare groove.

2c126d230d6c.curator_note: An open-to-close Rich Medina set billed explicitly as house/rare-groove/garage is exactly the deep-crate education worth clearing a whole Saturday night for at a tiki bar like High Tide.
2c126d230d6c.description: All-night open-to-close set (10pm) from Philly selector Rich Medina — house, rare groove and garage classics — at High Tide's Little Tokyo/Arts District bar.

bf5bb21c979b.curator_note: TikTok-viral is a red flag on paper, but the jazz-house sound is legit and a 5pm rooftop slot at Harbor House is the right room for it — closer to a sunset groove set than a hype booking.
bf5bb21c979b.description: 5pm sunset rooftop party at Harbor House DTLA headlined by Oslo jazz-house producer Dublon.

6d1613301e21.curator_note: Not remotely the club lane, but Kacey's a real Spotify staple for you and this is the 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour hitting DTLA — go for the songs, not the scene.
